decisions.reason: Both source/white/cyan/alpha pages and complete new raw master actually viewed. The first neck repair improves head roundness but still leaves a separate elongated exposed yellow neck stalk between the curved chin and the low dark OPEN V; it narrows down into the garment. Shorten and broaden this transition decisively: near-round compact mascot head with a curved lower chin seated naturally immediately above the actual garment opening, with no separate long human-like neck column. Fit the original dark garment circumference/shoulders to the mascot body. Preserve the actual low OPEN neckline and exposed upper-body area without closing the V or inventing a standing collar, shirt, tie or cream bib. Preserve source swept/gathered brown hair, smooth female face, original pose/gaze/expression/light and unchanged frame/paper/opaque backing. This is one new actual art followup of a returned image, not a service retry.
